description: Generate one language WITHOUT spending a build, and return the emitted file paths (and optionally contents). This is the fast loop for generator changes.

include_content.description: Include file contents. Defaults to false (paths only) to keep the response small.

path_filter.description: Only return files whose path contains this substring.

project_id.description: Project id. Optional, falls back to the CLI's selected project.
